what_it_does: This paper is a reproducibility evaluation of the X-MoE paper, which proposes a system for training emerging Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures on high-performance computing (HPC) platforms. MoE architectures use multiple independent sub-networks (experts) that process different parts of the data to achieve efficient scaling. The evaluation was conducted as part of the SC25 Reproducibility Committee's review process to independently verify the published findings and methodology.
